status: POST-HOC hypothesis, formulated 2026-10-05 AFTER exp-h18-001 was known; frozen before any H18w code or run. Lower evidential weight than a preregistered hypothesis; reported as such.
author_decision: User asked for a weak version of H18 (2026-10-05) and approved this plan; H18 stays REJECTED (value claim) permanently.
claim: The same generic Engine (v1.2, unchanged) governs the real hypothesis-driven lifecycle of operational-ontology-poc through ordinary domain declarations: it accepts exactly the transitions the independent lifecycle oracle accepts, makes verdicts reproducible from frozen evidence, keeps every canonical change traceable to Git, and needs no Project-specific Engine branch.
dropped_from_H18: S5 (>=25% lower bespoke surface than the file-only baseline)
R2 (parity/worse bespoke surface in all task classes)
support_if: S1: 0 illegal lifecycle transitions accepted across >= 3,000 unique generated sequences
S1b (stricter than H18): 0 legal lifecycle transitions refused, i.e. step-by-step agreement with the oracle in both directions
S2: 100% of authoritative verdicts reproducible from frozen evidence/evaluator
S3: 0 canonical ontology-only changes lacking a Git trace
S4: 0 Project-domain branches in the generic Engine
S6: all H18 target mutations detected (post-freeze threshold edit, verdict without evidence, detached commit provenance)
reject_if: Any of S1/S1b/S3/S4 violated, or any core governance invariant bypassable
inconclusive_if: fewer than 3,000 unique sequences, or any H18 hostile-edit class missing from the corpus
invalid_if: the Engine (src/eoo_engine, src/eoo_engine_git) differs from tag r2-engine-v1.2
the lifecycle oracle (src/hdd/project_lifecycle_reference.py, oracles/h18) is changed
harness files dirty at run time

candidate_change_allowed.what: project domain contract v3 (domains/project/ir.v3.json + logic/payload bindings + CHANGES_v3.md); ordinary declarations only
scope: wire the existing policy conflicting_change_denied_with_conflict into the action(s) where the exp-h18-001 self-supersession was accepted
make new_experiment_version link the new Experiment to its predecessor (an ordinary link type may be added) so legal version chains are accepted
forbidden: any oracle or harness change that alters what counts as legal
removing a class from the generated corpus

run.harness: the H18 harness unchanged except an evaluator variant that maps evidence to the clauses above
run.where: isolated git worktree by the orchestrator

downstream: H19 depends on H18w (author decision 2026-10-05) instead of the rejected value claim of H18.
